description: Simulate events through a walkerOS flow without making real API calls. For destinations: event is a walkerOS event { name: "entity action", data: {...} }. For sources: event is { content, trigger?: { type?, options? } }, where content is the walkerOS event { name: "entity action", data: {...} }. step (required) targets the step to simulate, e.g. "destination.gtag". Use flow_examples to discover available test data. IMPORTANT: Destinations with require (e.g. require: ["consent"]) stay pending until that collector event fires — simulation will error "not found" if require is not satisfied. Remove require from config or provide consent/user events before simulating. Separately, destinations with consent (e.g. consent: { marketing: true }) only receive events where the event includes matching consent. Mapping transforms event names and data at the destination level. Policy redacts or injects fields before mapping runs.

configPath.description: Path to flow configuration file, URL, or inline JSON string

event.description: For destinations: { name, data, consent? }. Include consent (e.g. { marketing: true }) to satisfy destination consent requirements. For sources: { content, trigger? } where content is the walkerOS event { name, data }. Can also be a JSON string or file path.

ingest.description: Pipeline context a transformer reads via ctx.ingest, e.g. { url } for a request decoder. Only used for transformer steps.

state.description: Collector-state snapshot for collector steps: consent/user/globals/timing. Seeds the collector before enrichment runs.

verbose.description: Include full payload per destination (default: false)

name: flow_simulate

payload.description: All intercepted API calls (only when verbose: true)

title: Simulate Flow
